left.raw_text: Must have pathologically confirmed invasive adenocarcinoma
or ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast.

right.raw_text: Patients must have undergone segmental mastectomy (i.e., lumpectomy).

left.raw_text: Patients must not have received prior radiation therapy to the breast.
Patients must not have active local-regional disease prior to registration.
Women of child-bearing age will be given a serum pregnancy test prior to study entry
to ensure they are not pregnant.

right.raw_text: They will also be counseled on the importance of avoiding pregnancy and hormonal contraception while undergoing radiation therapy.

left.raw_text: Patients must not have a serious medical or psychiatric illness

right.raw_text: All patients must be informed of the investigational nature of this study and give written informed consent in accordance with institutional and federal guidelines.
